posts.cooked:
I completely forgot to re-listen to it yesterday!

I tell ya, turning 40 was just fine. It wasn’t until 3 months later that my body started to break down and utterly betray me! :’)

Stop giving Adam existential crises! XD

I have to imagine that was not the Dr. Fate, or it would have been signed Schmoctor Schmate.

The Parse questions were so weird… There was some extra back and forth cut from the final episode, but I don’t think the guys ever got on the same page as the asker re: which images were actually being talked about. I certainly didn’t!

I, for one, welcome our new Joeverlord. :V

I really have to know if Lethal Kontest was spelled with a K.

I hope the Wraith musical includes a number about how criminals are a superstitious, cowardly lot. V:
